caption:
Koko's knees grumble on every step down the stairs. Is reformer Pilates an option?

Your first session usually starts with questions about your knees, daily activities and goals, plus a few simple movement checks. Reformer footwork lets you strengthen thighs and hips lying down, with less body weight through the knee, and springs can be adjusted as you go.

Mild aching during or after exercise is common with knee osteoarthritis and usually settles within a day. Over the weeks, standing work like step-ups and sit-to-stands is often added.

A knee that locks, gives way or becomes hot and very swollen is worth checking first. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
